record.name: WhatsApp Business
record.one_liner: Official API platform to send and receive WhatsApp messages, manage business profiles, and automate customer communications.
record.access_note: Developers sign up on the Meta for Developer portal and set up a business account to access test resources for free.
record.api_note: Covers sending messages, managing templates, webhook events, and business profiles.

evidence.quote: All API calls require authentication with access tokens.
When you get started with Cloud API, a test WhatsApp account, test Messaging account, and test business phone number are automatically created for you.
The WhatsApp Business Platform is built on Graph API and uses HTTP protocol.
The WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API enables you to programmatically message and call on WhatsApp.
